text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the same order (templates, then style objects, then animate calls), the same filters and the same Site values, and `InScript` is left with only a few shallow `if`s, so it should be well under 15. I couldn't see the declared types of `guards`, `keyframes` and `projectReset` in the visible hunk, so the build depends on them matching the new parameter types (`IReadOnlySet<string>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `Func<Family, bool>`).
